monophthongs.name: Close-mid front diphthongized
monophthongs.us_tip: Starts at /e/ and glides up towards /ɪ/.

monophthongs.name: Near-open front unrounded
monophthongs.us_tip: Very distinct in GenAm, jaw drops significantly.

monophthongs.name: Open back unrounded (Father-Bother)
monophthongs.us_tip: In US English, 'hot' and 'father' share this same unrounded open vowel.

monophthongs.name: Open-mid back rounded
monophthongs.us_tip: Slight lip rounding; merges with /ɑ/ in many US dialects.

monophthongs.name: Close-mid back diphthongized
monophthongs.us_tip: Back rounded glide starting from /o/ to /ʊ/.

monophthongs.name: Near-close near-back rounded
monophthongs.us_tip: Relaxed back vowel with moderate lip rounding.

monophthongs.name: Mid-central (Schwa)
monophthongs.us_tip: Most common English sound, completely unstressed.

monophthongs.name: R-colored mid-central (Stressed)
monophthongs.us_tip: Characteristic GenAm rhotic vowel. Tongue curls or bunches back.

monophthongs.name: R-colored schwa (Unstressed)
monophthongs.us_tip: Unstressed syllable ending with rhotic coloring.

american_special_features.name: Flap T (/ɾ/)
american_special_features.description: When /t/ or /d/ occurs between two vowels and the second vowel is unstressed, it turns into an alveolar tap.

american_special_features.name: Rhoticity (R-coloring)
american_special_features.description: Unlike British Received Pronunciation, General American pronounces /r/ in all positions (after vowels and at word endings).

american_special_features.name: Yod-Dropping
american_special_features.description: General American omits the /j/ glide after alveolar consonants /t, d, n, s, z, θ/.
